column3: Directly pairs avoidance of major prohibitions with removal of evils, clarifying the protective-repair relation.
Sets great success in truthful conduct and enduring divine approval; it broadens the outcome side.
Joins forgiveness, gardens, and the reward of workers, supporting reward as a return connected to action.
A close parallel pairs faith and righteous action with removal of evils and entry, adding a distinct route to the same repair.
Extends the local household setting through proportionate provision and relief after hardship.
Only repeats the language of great success across worldly and final life without specifying its relation to 65:5.
Supplies the preceding procedural setting: mindful conduct, fair choices, witness, and an opening from difficulty.
Shows the later messenger-and-clear-signs sequence and an enduring provisioned outcome for faith and action.
Frames descent as ordered by the Lord across what is before, behind, and between, supporting the command's governed descent.
Directly precedes 65:5 with measured family timings and mindful conduct making the affair easier.
Offers a generic recompense-and-garden outcome, already covered by closer reward passages.

Provides a detailed model of measured, just, non-harming agreement under mindfulness, relevant to fair local ordering.

Contributes household intimacy, forgiveness, stated limits, and mindfulness as a bounded practical order.

Adds acknowledgement of wrongdoing, seeking forgiveness, and non-persistence as a practical return after fault.

States a direct route from wrongdoing and self-wronging to seeking divine forgiveness.

Joins faith and righteous action to forgiveness and a great reward in a compact parallel to the focus.

Connects collective faith and mindfulness with opened blessings, extending the material-consequence dimension.

Sets faith and costly action within a scale of greater rank and success, supplying a reward-and-action comparison.
Describes mercy, good pleasure, and enduring gardens as divine glad tidings.

Combines return and seeking forgiveness with a measured good provision and apportioned grace.

States that divine mercy reaches whom God wills and that the reward of those doing good is not lost.

Combines repentance, faith, and righteous action with garden entry and the removal of wrong.

Makes pardon and overlooking wrongdoing a commanded social practice under the hope of divine forgiveness.
Combines obedience, fear, and mindfulness with success, giving a concise conduct-to-outcome parallel.

Transforms the treatment of evil deeds through repentance, faith, and righteous action, a significant repair parallel.
Links patient endurance with a lofty recompense and enduring reception.

Links faith and righteous action with forgiveness and noble provision.

Pairs following the reminder and fearing the Merciful unseen with forgiveness and noble reward.
